question: State Mining Readiness Index in India has how many indicators?
solution:
The correct answer is __**7**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 
• The **State Mining Readiness Index** is an initiative introduced by the **NITI Aayog** to evaluate the mining sector's performance across Indian states. 
• The index is based on **7 indicators** that collectively measure the mining readiness of states in terms of policies, infrastructure, and governance. 
• These indicators include aspects like **geological potential, policy environment, ease of doing business, infrastructure availability**, and **environmental and social sustainability**. 
• The index aims to foster competition among states to improve their mining ecosystems and attract investments in the sector. 
• The evaluation is conducted using a structured framework, ensuring transparency and uniformity across states. 
• This initiative plays a vital role in promoting sustainable mining practices and optimizing resource utilization.
